title.zh: 将东达沃省赫内罗索市镇塔加贝贝描笼涯的塔加贝贝小学更名为Hadji Hamiri Musa小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Tagabebe Elementary School in Barangay Tagabebe, Municipality of Gov. Generoso, Province of Davao Oriental, to Hadji Hamiri Musa Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Tagabebe Elementary School in Barangay Tagabebe, Municipality of Gov. Generoso, Province of Davao Oriental, to Hadji Hamiri Musa Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường Tiểu học Tagabebe tại Barangay Tagabebe, Đô thị Gov. Generoso, Tỉnh Davao Oriental thành Trường Tiểu học Hadji Hamiri Musa
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Tagabebe ในบารังไกย์ Tagabebe เทศบาล Gov. Generoso จังหวัด Davao Oriental เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Hadji Hamiri Musa
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Dasar Tagabebe di Barangay Tagabebe, Kotamadya Gov. Generoso, Provinsi Davao Oriental menjadi Sekolah Dasar Hadji Hamiri Musa
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Sekolah Rendah Tagabebe di Barangay Tagabebe, Perbandaran Gov. Generoso, Wilayah Davao Oriental kepada Sekolah Rendah Hadji Hamiri Musa

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6785_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Tagabebe Elementary School in Barangay Tagabebe, Municipality of Gov. Generoso, Province of Davao Oriental, shall hereafter be known as the Hadji Hamiri Musa Elementary School, in honor of its donor, the late Hadji Hamiri Musa.
The Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports is hereby empowered and directed to issue rules and regulations to carry out the purpose of this Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
